Export WhatsApp Chat: The Ultimate Guide

WhatsApp, a widely-used messaging platform, often necessitates the need to export chats for various reasons like backup, archiving, or transferring data. This guide offers step-by-step instructions tailored for different devices and provides insights into each method.

Learn how to export your WhatsApp chat for various purposes such as backup, analysis, or archiving. This guide covers iOS, Android, and PC platforms, catering to both individual and group chats. Furthermore it gives you hands-on tips on how you can create a PDF from your WhatsApp chat.
Option 1: iPhone (iOS) - Export as a .txt File
Open WhatsApp and select the desired chat.
Tap on the chat name for more options.
: Exports only the chat text as a .txt file.
Save or share the exported file.
Option 2: Android - Export as a .txt File
Open WhatsApp and choose your chat.
Access chat settings and select 'Email chat'.
: Exports chat with photos and videos.
: Only text of the chat is exported.
Exporting via WhatsApp Web is currently not supported. Use your connected phone for export.
Transfer your exported chat data (.txt or .zip) to your PC.
Step-by-step instructions for exporting a WhatsApp chat on iPhone, Android and PC — single chats and groups.
